docs.title: PLG Strategy by 15 September — Measurement, Signups, Feedback Loop
docs.content:
# PLG Strategy by 15 September

## The Goal
A readable PLG signal by 15 September — measurement, real signups, and a live feedback loop, in that order.

## Three Phases
1. **Measurement** — Get analytics working end-to-end (Contentsquare, HubSpot events, Google Ads conversion tracking).
2. **Real Signups** — Drive actual traffic that converts through a working signup flow.
3. **Live Feedback Loop** — Close the loop so every experiment teaches us something within 48 hours.

## Key Metrics to Track
- Homepage bounce rate
- Scroll rate on pricing page
- Home-to-pricing conversion
- Signup completion rate
- api_key_created events (HubSpot product events)
- Cost per signup by channel

## Decision Log
- 31 Aug: Leo named as end-to-end funnel owner.
- 1 Sep: Engineering time for distribution loop still unfunded — marked blocked.
